controls.statement: Define the observation period before declaring the launch complete.
controls.primary_reason: The control asks for a defined observation period, which can be decided exactly from an authenticated release-bound record with finite start and end semantics.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: The launch record defines a finite observation start and end, or a finite duration with an objective start event.

controls.statement: Define who has authority to pause, continue, expand, or roll back the launch.
controls.primary_reason: Authority for the four listed launch actions is an exact record fact that can be validated against an authenticated release authority matrix.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: An authenticated release authority record assigns authorized roles or identities for pause, continue, expand, and rollback actions.

controls.statement: Establish expected traffic and customer cohorts.
controls.primary_reason: Establishing expected traffic and cohorts can be checked as a release-bound forecast record with bounded numeric traffic values and objective cohort selectors.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: The release forecast records expected traffic using bounded numeric units and defines customer cohorts with objective selectors.

controls.statement: Establish whether the launch is internal, private, regional, percentage-based, invitation-only, or public.
controls.primary_reason: The launch exposure type is an exact release configuration fact and can be validated from a version-bound record using the allowed launch-mode vocabulary.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: The release record declares one or more launch modes from internal, private, regional, percentage-based, invitation-only, or public.

controls.statement: Ensure marketing, sales, support, and operations use the same release date and scope.
controls.primary_reason: With a complete inventory of the four named functions and authenticated release records, their release date and scope values can be compared exactly.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: Marketing, sales, support, and operations each have an authenticated record for the same release identity.
The release date and scope fields are identical across the four function records.

controls.statement: Every production service has a named business owner.
controls.primary_reason: A complete production-service inventory can be joined exactly to authenticated ownership records to find any service lacking a named business owner.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: The current environment evidence provides a complete inventory of production services in assessment scope.
Every inventoried production service maps to one active named business owner in the ownership registry.

controls.statement: Every production service has a named engineering owner.
controls.primary_reason: A complete production-service inventory can be joined exactly to authenticated ownership records to find any service lacking a named engineering owner.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: The current environment evidence provides a complete inventory of production services in assessment scope.
Every inventoried production service maps to one active named engineering owner in the ownership registry.

controls.statement: Every data set has an accountable data owner.
controls.primary_reason: Given a complete scoped data-set inventory, the presence and current identity of an accountable data owner is an exact registry comparison.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: The current data catalog provides a complete inventory of in-scope data sets.
Every inventoried data set maps to an active accountable data owner in the ownership registry.

controls.statement: Every security-sensitive component has a security contact.
controls.primary_reason: Security sensitivity may be supplied by an approved classification record; every component so classified can then be checked exactly for an active security contact.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: The component inventory includes an authoritative security-sensitivity classification for every in-scope component.
Every component classified security-sensitive maps to an active security contact.

controls.statement: Every third-party integration has an owner.
controls.primary_reason: A complete integration inventory and authenticated ownership registry allow an exact anti-join for third-party integrations without an active owner.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: The current release evidence provides a complete inventory of third-party integrations.
Every inventoried third-party integration maps to an active owner in the ownership registry.

controls.statement: Every operational dashboard, alert, and runbook has an owner.
controls.primary_reason: Complete inventories of dashboards, alerts, and runbooks can be joined to authenticated ownership records with no semantic judgment in the final result.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: Current monitoring and repository evidence inventories every in-scope dashboard, alert, and runbook.
Every inventoried dashboard, alert, and runbook maps to an active owner.

controls.statement: Every scheduled job and background process has an owner.
controls.primary_reason: A complete scheduler and process inventory can be compared exactly with current ownership records for missing or inactive owners.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: Current environment evidence inventories every scheduled job and background process in scope.
Every inventoried scheduled job and background process maps to an active owner.

controls.statement: Escalation paths include primary, secondary, management, security, privacy/legal, and provider escalation contacts.
controls.primary_reason: The statement names required escalation categories, so authenticated escalation records and provider applicability can be validated without inventing additional categories.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: The escalation record contains active primary, secondary, management, security, and privacy or legal contacts.
Every inventoried external provider has an active provider escalation contact when provider escalation is applicable.

controls.statement: Maintain a release-specific risk register.
controls.primary_reason: The control asks for a release-specific risk register; an authenticated current register bound to the exact release identity is an objectively verifiable record fact.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: An authenticated risk register exists and is bound to the assessed release identity, scope digest, and current revision.

controls.statement: Give each risk an owner, likelihood, impact, treatment, evidence, and review date.
controls.primary_reason: Given the complete release risk register, the seven named fields can be validated for every risk record without judging the chosen values.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: Every risk record has nonempty owner, likelihood, impact, treatment, evidence reference, and finite review-date fields.

controls.statement: Record accepted residual risk and the person authorized to accept it.
controls.primary_reason: The control concerns recording an acceptance and authorized accepter, both of which can be validated against signed risk decisions and the authority registry.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: Every accepted residual-risk record identifies the risk, decision, timestamp, release scope, and accepting identity.
The accepting identity held the required risk-acceptance authority at the recorded decision time.

controls.statement: Review high-impact assumptions with independent subject-matter experts.
controls.primary_reason: The occurrence, scope, reviewer identity, subject-matter role, and independence of required reviews can be checked from assumption and organization records.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: Every assumption classified high-impact has a signed review record bound to the assumption and release.
Each reviewer has the required subject-matter role and is independent under the approved organization policy.

controls.statement: Ensure risk exceptions cannot remain open indefinitely.
controls.primary_reason: An exception cannot remain open indefinitely when every open record has a finite enforced expiry and expired exceptions are objectively rejected.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: Every open risk exception has a finite expiry timestamp and a current accountable owner.
No exception remains open after its recorded expiry timestamp.

controls.statement: Ensure compensating controls are tested rather than merely described.
controls.primary_reason: A complete compensating-control register can be checked for current executed test evidence, which distinguishes an actual test from a written description.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: Every declared compensating control references a current executed test result bound to its implementation and release scope.
No compensating control relies only on descriptive repository or record evidence in place of an executed result.

controls.statement: Apply separation of duties to high-impact changes and approvals.
controls.primary_reason: With an approved definition of high-impact changes, complete change records, and identity data, actor separation can be evaluated exactly for every change and approval.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: Every change classified high-impact has authenticated implementer and approver identities.
No prohibited identity or role overlap exists between implementation and approval under the versioned separation policy.

controls.statement: Mark Internet-facing and externally reachable interfaces.
controls.primary_reason: Given authoritative reachable-interface inventory and a structured architecture model, every externally reachable interface can be compared exactly with its marker.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: Current environment evidence provides a complete inventory of Internet-facing and externally reachable interfaces.
Every inventoried externally reachable interface is present and explicitly marked in the structured architecture record.

controls.statement: Obtain independent review for high-value or high-risk systems.
controls.primary_reason: Applicability can come from the approved value or risk tier, while signed review and reviewer independence can be validated from current authoritative records.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: The approved risk record objectively marks whether the system is high-value or high-risk under the versioned organizational policy.
Every applicable system has a signed independent-review record bound to the release and an identity independent under the approved policy.
